description:
Option C, step C1 (approved page https://claude.ai/artifact/HJ4StaQ4ggt6yt2Fus6pX7).

A guard helper call unfolds into the caller's dispatch matrix as the facts of the helper's clauses. A raising clause counts as false. Constant conjuncts are evaluated. The embedded plan remains only for helpers that do not unfold.

Removes: type_predicate_of, answers_only_for / types_its_calls_need, and the guard leaf's Whole read of a callable (executable_facts.rs:656). That read is also the source of the construction wrapper a case over a callable builds under is_function(h, 1) (Make Distiller Fast finding 1, absorbed here).

Related open tickets to reconcile on the page or at build: fz-sc8.54 (A guard helper that is only ever folded builds no plan of its own), fz-sc8.215 (guard helper selected by argument types), fz-ep5.4 (type predicate recognised from guards).

Build finding (Callables, 2026-11-24): C1 does not remove the guard leaf's Whole read for is_function/2. The unfolded residue fz_function_arity(f) == 2 is still an extern call on the callable, so u6 and p15 keep their wrapper. That removal (executable_facts.rs:656) moves to fz-yh5.13. C1 does not subsume fz-sc8.54: the job trace for `when is_integer(x)` is identical on base and C1 (ReifyGuardDispatch 6).
title: A guard helper call unfolds into the caller's dispatch matrix as its clauses' facts
